FM06.reasoning: The agent creates validation sets during the cross-validation loop but completely ignores them, never computing or reporting any validation metric to estimate model generalization.

FM12.reasoning: The agent uses an arbitrary, hardcoded set of weights to blend the three models without any visible tuning, validation, or stacking to justify this combination.

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect submission ID generation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the original ID column from the test set and replaces it with a simple sequential range (np.arange) in the final submission file. In almost all tasks, test dataset IDs are specific identifiers that must match exactly, meaning the generated submission will be misaligned or rejected.

summary: The agent implements a reasonable preprocessing and feature engineering pipeline, followed by an ensemble of three gradient boosting models. However, it critically fails to compute any validation scores despite setting up a cross-validation loop, leaving it blind to model performance. Furthermore, it relies on untuned, hardcoded weights for its ensemble and generates invalid, sequential IDs for the submission file instead of retaining the actual test set IDs.
